lines.text: Many learners say: I did a mistake in the test.
Better: I made a mistake in the test.
Made! Sorry, I made a mistake.

data.wrong: I did a mistake in the test.
data.right: I made a mistake in the test.

native.tip: हिंदी में “गलती की” कहते हैं, इसलिए do याद आता है; अंग्रेज़ी में mistake के साथ make बोलें।
native.caption: क्या आप भी यही कहते हैं? “I did a mistake in the test.” 😅 सही रूप है “I made a mistake in the test.” क्योंकि mistake के साथ make आता है। Carlos की आवाज़ सुनकर दोहराइए! Lexkite ऐप में और अभ्यास करें।
native.comment: उत्तर: “made”। अब इसी तरह अपना एक वाक्य लिखिए। मुफ़्त क्विज़ यहाँ: {link}

en.tip: Many learners use do with mistake, but English uses make.
en.caption: Do you say this? “I did a mistake in the test.” 😅 The right way is “I made a mistake in the test.” This is right because mistake goes with make. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
